messages:
emily: hey team quick one  trying to pick up a specialty injection at CVS specialty but they say the BIN/PCN on the e-card doesn't match their system and they won't accept the e-card. They want the carrier's 800 number and the plan's tax ID. Is there a faster route than me chasing the insurer?

sara (People Ops): hi emily  ugh, annoying. Short: you can usually get pharmacy to process if they have member ID+group+DOB and the insurer phone/BIN/PCN. If the BIN/PCN on the e-card is wrong or outdated, ask the pharmacy to call provider services (the number they gave) and do an eligibility lookup with member ID.

emily: they say the pharmacy system routes specialty claims to a different PBM and the BIN/PCN must match exactly or claim rejects. they want plan tax id for third-party billing too.

sara (People Ops): ok - two parallel paths: 1) Ask pharmacy to call the insurer's pharmacy help line to verify routing (give them member id + DOB + drug name + prior auth number if you have it). 2) If the pharmacy needs tax ID/NPI, give them the plan group tax ID on the e-card or ask pharmacy to request a manual override and to accept a photo of the e-card + verbal confirmation from insurer. DM me the pharmacy branch name and the rejection code and i'll call insurer/provider relations.

pharmacy-rep: from pharmacy: if BIN/PCN mismatch we can manually adjudicate if insurer provides a bank/phone confirmation and the member signs a consent to bill. For specialty drugs we often need NPI of prescriber and the specialty PA auth#. If patient needs drug today we can dispense a short emergency supply while we confirm coverage.

emily: i do have a prior auth number from the clinic, prescriber NPI, and a scanned e-card. They still want tax id. can you share a short message i can send so they stop repeating the same steps?

sara (People Ops): sure - copy/paste this to the pharmacy: 

```
Hi [Pharmacy Rep],

Member: Emily Lastname | DOB: [MM/DD/YYYY] | Member ID: [########]
Plan: Redwood Choice PPO (group [######])
Drug: [Drug Name] (specialty injection)
Prescriber NPI: [#########]
Prior Auth: [PA#]

Please contact [Insurer Pharmacy Help/Provider Line] and verify eligibility and routing for this specialty claim. If BIN/PCN on your terminal doesn't match, please request a manual override and accept the attached screenshot of the e-card. If insurer requires tax ID for billing, please note the insurer's guidance and provide the reference number. If immediate dispensing is refused, please dispense an emergency fill of [# days] while coverage is confirmed.

Thanks,
Emily
```

benefits-bot: automated note  specialty pharmacy notes: keep prescriber NPI, HCPCS/CPT or NDC, prior auth code, and member DOB handy. Typical issuer turnaround for routing fixes is 1-2 business days; pharmacies can sometimes do a 1-3 day emergency dispense. Save any reference numbers and screenshot phone confirmations.

omar: small tip  if pharmacy asks for plan tax id, ask them which tax id (employer vs. carrier). Usually the PBM uses BIN/PCN and carrier tax id isn't needed unless billing as secondary. If they insist, ask them to call insurer and get a reference #, then DM me and sara and we'll follow-up.

emily: thanks! sending the template now and DMing the branch name. appreciate the quick help. :pray:
